layman_headline: SOL is closing in on its profit target — sit tight and let the trade play out.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive rally week, with Bitcoin up 23% and many altcoins up 30-50%+. Our Solana position is up 9.4% and approaching the $100 exit target. XRP is slightly underwater at -2.6% but well above its stop-loss. Every swing candidate on the watchlist is already overbought or heavily extended after huge weekly moves, making new entries very risky right now.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. SOL is close to its $100 target — consider taking profit if it reaches that level in the next few days. Keep XRP with its $1.30 stop-loss in place. Don't chase anything new after this massive rally week.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates show deeply negative composite scores: LIT (RSI 74.6, +56% 7d), PUMP (RSI 86.1, +95% 7d), MON (RSI 61.7, +48% 7d), MORPHO (+45.8% 7d with 27.9% single-day move), and XRP (+53.1% 7d). Every candidate is overbought or extended. Fear & Greed at 73 with an improving trend suggests the rally may have legs but chasing at these levels offers poor risk/reward. BTC dominance at 59.1% remains elevated, historically unfavorable for alt entries. The prudent move is to manage existing positions — SOL is 4.8% from target, and XRP needs more time to recover. No new entry meets our risk criteria.

context_banner: After the biggest weekly rally in months, all candidates are overbought — protect gains and wait for pullback entries.

XRP's biggest weekly gain in 21 months driven by Treasury buyback and curve control hopes — macro catalyst is real but XRP is already +53% on the week.
Elevated volumes across the board (BTC $29.6B, ETH $16.4B, XRP $5.3B) confirm genuine buying but suggest the move is mature rather than early-stage.
